title: Every Famous Animal That Hunts Doug (Croc, Polar Bear, Hippo Marathon)
intro: Doug has met five animals that people call dangerous. Four of them are worse than their reputation. One is only mostly worse. He is still going to meet all of them back to back, because nobody has stopped the narrator yet.
description: Five of the channel's animal episodes in one sitting: the saltwater crocodile, the polar bear, the leopard seal, the hippo and a tournament of every animal Doug might beat in a fight.
